editorial.summary: A 1:39 official trailer assembled from music and at least three short interview fragments. One fragment dismisses college and grades, then cuts into art-school nude drawing, an upside-down drawing exercise and badly damaged rooftop/tagging/sexual imagery. Another speaker praises David Choe’s individuality and ability; a final voice challenges normal/weird/strange labels before collapsing into an unintelligible family-related clause. Every idea and source mask remains, but the montage is not reconstructed as one argument. “Six-year-old naked dude” is not accepted as a minor reference because the age phrase is implausible and audio-required. Rooftop, tagging, dreadlocks/armpits and the final family sentence remain unresolved. Music and editing cannot supply speaker identities; zero named turns ship.
